title: Sequence Practice 1
subject: rla
passage:
TEXT A - Volunteer Orientation

New volunteers first watch a ten-minute safety video. They then sign the equipment form. After a supervisor checks the form, each volunteer receives a storage key. At the end of the shift, the key is returned before the volunteer signs out.

TEXT B - Soil Test

A researcher collects soil from three garden beds and seals each sample. In the lab, the samples are dried overnight. The dry soil is weighed, mixed with distilled water, and allowed to settle. The researcher records the pH only after the mixture has settled for twenty minutes.

TEXT C - Repair Ticket

A tenant submits a repair ticket. The building office checks whether a technician is available and then offers an appointment time. The tenant confirms the time before the office sends building-entry instructions to the technician. The ticket is closed after the tenant confirms that the repair is complete.

TEXT D - The Errand

Noah picked up a library book, then walked to the pharmacy. Before leaving the pharmacy, he checked the bus app and saw a delay. He bought a bottle of water while he waited. When the app showed the bus approaching, he crossed to the stop.
